name: Shenzhen Aoni Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Aoni Electronic Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of audio-visual hardware products in China and internationally. The company offers intelligent video terminal products, such as low-power, indoor, outdoor, office and teaching, conference, and human verification cameras, as well as smart video doorbells, NVR kits, and baby care products. It also provides high-performance computing terminals, including laptops, AI PCs, and flat products; intelligent vehicle terminals consisting of vehicle cameras, smart dashcams, streaming rearview mirrors, electronic exterior rearview mirrors, and AEBS autonomous collision avoidance systems; smart audio terminals, …
